changelog:
💳 A reply the proxy cuts at max_tokens or a stop sequence now logs the credits Kiro bills for it; it used to log 0. Replies cut while Kiro is still writing stay free.
🔎 Hosted web search on the OpenAI APIs: /v1/responses returns web_search_call items and url_citation annotations, /v1/chat/completions returns url_citation annotations and accepts web_search_options, and every search round's tokens are counted.
📋 The request log shows each web search and each later round as its own attempt.
⚡ An over-long input is answered from the first Kiro endpoint, in about 2 s instead of 6 s.
